inspiration.observed_pattern: MAKE_SET maps set bits in a numeric mask to comma-separated positional labels and omits NULL labels.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Minimized independently authored scalar regression with two selected non-NULL bits, one selected NULL slot, and an unselected bit. It isolates MAKE_SET's ordering and NULL omission without UPDATE or table state.

fixture_notes: Mask 13 selects bits zero, two, and three; the first and third labels remain while the selected NULL label is omitted, yielding north,south.
determinism_notes: All mask and label literals are fixed and the scalar projection has no environmental inputs.
